summary: The default linear strategy waits for each task to finish on all hosts before the next; strategy: free runs tasks on each host as fast as forks allow, helping when one slow host stalls the play.
questions: Why does my network playbook wait for one slow device?
What's the difference between linear and free strategy?
How can I speed up a playbook across many hosts?

answer_card.title: Use strategy: free for speed
answer_card.answer_md:
- **linear** (default): each task must finish on all hosts before any host starts the next. Use it when every step must succeed everywhere first.
- **free**: each host moves on as soon as it can, using forks more efficiently.

If one slow host holds up every task, set at play level:
```yaml
strategy: free
```
